title: skill-contract task-plan/v1 payload
description: The predicate.payload of a task-plan/v1 envelope written by spec_to_tasks.py --envelope.

spec.description: Repo-relative path of the spec the plan came from.

depends_on.description: Optional: task ids this task's requirement's [after: ...] hint resolved to.

features.description: Optional: the verify skill's feature-map ids this task proves (a requirement's [feature: ...] hint). factory-conductor's evidence gate needs evidence for each.

predicate.description: Optional: the observable success predicate an agent can drive and see (a requirement's [proof: ...] hint). Not 'tests pass'.

independence.description: Optional: "parallel-safe" ([parallel-safe]) or the task ids this one depends on ([after: ...]); feeds factory-conductor's independence partition.

verification.description: Optional: the spec's ## Verification section. factory-conductor runs a plan that carries it under its evidence gate.

skill.description: Repo-relative path of the verify-<app> skill directory (verification-skill-forge generates it).

constraints.description: Optional: the spec's Constrain-step constraints, when it has any (task-plan/v1 stays v1 — additive).

required_truths.description: Optional: the spec's Anchor-step required truths, when it has any.

intake_items.description: Optional: the ops-intake item ids (intake-item/v1) the spec answers, from its ## Intake section. ops-intake's sync finds the plan that names a picked item through it.

decisions.description: Optional: the spec's unattended-mode Decisions sweep, when it has any.
